chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Wembley, 2022. Liverpool play Manchester City. City pass the ball back to their keeper. Sadio Mané sprints straight at him. A heavy touch... Mané slides in... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. The moment the ball goes back, Mané is already running, so the keeper has no time.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the touch runs away from the keeper, and Mané slides the ball into the net. Liverpool lead two-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when they pass back, press straight away. Win the ball high up, and it is a short run to goal!
